0001 · Cover · Analysis wing encyclopedic report

0002 · Thesis · Do not implement PTP/OTC — re-enter the book

This client already posted GR 101 (EKBE, MZ-RM-*, plant 1710) and MIRO RE (RBKP, USSU-VSF0x, 1710) and F2 billing (VBRK, 1710, USD) and OR sales orders (VBAK, 1710, one page ≈ USD 481,000).

What we broke: TG10 is third-party. What we misread: 500 hits as the population. What a 6–60 month program does: process change, not more SPRO. The factory is 139 PO types × 376 sales types × 98 release strategies. Almost all of it is idle relative to the BPINST 2017–18 book.

  • Config hop: CLIENT 1710 → determination table (T161A / T184 / TVAKZ / T163A) → master (MARC/KNVV/LFM1) → document (EKKO/VBAK).
  • Control hop: T16FS (98 strategies) → release / WEBRE / Hold 32… → ticket to MM or SD.
  • Stock hop: if material is TG10 (PD) → item cat S → no 101 → no EKBE=1 → no MIRO → AR/AP delay.
  • Working hop: if material is MZ-RM-R200-* → EKBE 101 on 1710 already LIVE → copy that path.
  • Org hop: 1710 works; 1000 rejects USSU-VSF01; EORD is on MOH1/SAO1 not 1710.
  • People hop: BPINST built the 2017–18 book; SV3_000349 is re-entering it; S4H_PURCH owns seed POs.
  • Cash hop: order/PO → fulfill → VBRK F2 or RBKP RE → BSID/BSIK → DSO / F110.
  • Integration hop: NAST → spool/IDoc EDIDC → partner; missing output looks like “SAP posted but customer never saw it.”
  1. User cannot find the 500-cap in F4 — check authorization + 500-cap SE16N lie.
  2. Wrong org/group (1000 / 001) — ME59N / vendor determination dump.
  3. Date mask UK 1710 (DD.MM.YYYY) vs US click — “Enter valid date.”
  4. Cost G/L 51600000 without CO object — two assignment lines.
  5. WEBRE required blank — cannot save.
  6. Hold 32… mistaken for 45… post — finance reconciles to nothing.
  7. Third-party GR 101 — deficit PU GR (already LIVE on TG10).
  8. Release strategy 98 rows — document stuck, ME28/ME29N not in SOP.

6 months: SOP — do not use TG10 for stock; use MZ-RM-*; EKGRP 002; never trust 500 hits. 12 months: source list on plant 1710; retire EKGRP 001 for auto-PO. 24 months: which of 139/376 types are unused — freeze shelfware in T161/TVAK. 36–60 months: contracts/SAs (ME31K/L) replace one-off NB/OR; FSCM credit; IDoc ORDRSP/INVOIC monitored in WE02; analysis wing auto-counts weekly.
